definitions.explanation: Returning to one's job or position after a period of leave, suspension, or absence.

examples.japanese: {育休|いくきゅう}{後|ご}に{復職|ふくしょく}した。
examples.english: She returned to work after parental leave.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}から{回復|かいふく}して、{来月|らいげつ}{復職|ふくしょく}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: Having recovered from illness, I plan to return to work next month.

examples.japanese: {復職|ふくしょく}{後|ご}は{時短勤務|じたんきんむ}で{働|はたら}くことになった。
examples.english: After returning to work, I'll be working reduced hours.

notes:
USAGE:
{復職|ふくしょく} is commonly used in HR and workplace contexts. It often refers to returning after {育児休暇|いくじきゅうか} (parental leave), {病気休暇|びょうききゅうか} (sick leave), or {休職|きゅうしょく} (leave of absence).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {復職|ふくしょく}する (to return to work)
- {復職|ふくしょく}{支援|しえん} (return-to-work support)
- {復職|ふくしょく}{後|ご} (after returning to work)

CONTRAST:
{休職|きゅうしょく} (leave of absence from work) is the antonym. {転職|てんしょく} (changing jobs) means moving to a different position entirely.
